verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents several automations that run without a human present. Incident Workflows use configurable "if-this-then-that" triggers and actions and can fire automatically for every P1/P2 incident. Event Orchestration deduplicates or suppresses alerts on its own, escalation policies automate assignment, and agents such as the Shift Agent and SRE Agent act in the background (the Shift Agent "coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention"). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that Incident Workflows and the AI agents work autonomously as claimed (community evidence covers only escalation), and evidence of general-purpose scheduled automations beyond incident- and event-triggered ones.
